name: hud_ui_triplet_entries_get_count
description: HudUiTripletEntries::GetCount returns zero for an empty entry vector, otherwise the number of 0x50-byte scoreboard entries between begin and end.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent HUD triplet/list-menu source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414670 validates returning zero when entries.begin is null and otherwise computing (entries.end - entries.begin) / 0x50.
The native triplet scoreboard smoke verifies entry counts for populated, grown, and removed scoreboard states through the public triplet entry vector.
